title: bench_core.ALIAS's opus row cites a kb line that states which model the opus alias names
goal: The kb states which model Claude Code's opus alias resolves to and from which version (research through /kb-research if it lacks it), and bench_core.ALIAS's opus row cites that line as the haiku and sonnet rows do; found by the SP-2vhfsn4o review (rag.py pack coverage none)

run: import re,sys; t=open('_tools/bench_core.py').read(); m=re.search(r'opus from [^#]*?(kb/public/[\w/.-]+\.md):(\d+)', t); ok=bool(m) and 'opus' in open(m.group(1)).read().splitlines()[int(m.group(2))-1].lower(); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

notes: Committed to SP-7y6dk257 at the operator's request of 2026-10-09 (benchmark follow-ups). check.py passes before the work: it pins that the kb stays valid after the fact lands. The second check fails until the ALIAS comment cites, as 'opus from VERSION PATH:LINE', a kb line that names opus.
